verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents first-party export of logs in open formats: CSV or JSON download, plus `bt sync pull` to pull data locally. Its API and self-hosting option, which keeps experiment logs, traces, datasets, and prompts in your own cloud, add to data ownership. However, export of all data types in open formats is not explicitly documented, so 'export everything and leave' is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of datasets, experiments, prompts and scorers in open formats; a documented full-account export or offboarding path; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Download logs as CSV or JSON, or pull them locally with `bt sync pull`.
It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions without leaving your terminal.
The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
keeping all customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, and prompts) within your own cloud account and region
